info.name: My Ride Nepal API Documentation
info.description: REST API of My Ride Nepal (/api/v1). The web SPA and the admin SPA authenticate with Laravel Sanctum cookie sessions: GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie, then send the X-XSRF-TOKEN header on every state-changing request. Errors are JSON: {message, errors?}. Validation errors use HTTP 422; unauthenticated 401; forbidden 403; password confirmation required 423; rate limited 429.
